name: What should I do if I notice a small leak or damage on my roof in between professional inspections?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if I notice a small leak or damage on my roof in between professional inspections?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you notice a small leak or damage, it's crucial to address it promptly to prevent further, more extensive issues. You can temporarily mitigate the problem by placing a bucket under the leak and moving any valuables. Avoid climbing on your roof if you're not experienced or if conditions are unsafe. Contacting a professional for a repair estimate immediately, particularly for residents in places like Allen or Celina, can help assess the situation and prevent minor problems from escalating into costly repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Address small leaks or damage promptly; temporarily contain leaks and avoid unsafe roof access. Contact a professional for an immediate repair estimate.
